title: Shift Handoff
story: Traffic is moving from a retiring worker to its standby replacement. Metrics must keep running throughout the handoff.
objective: Start standby, stop retiring, keep metrics running, and leave exactly three mission containers.
hints: Use docker ps -a to compare every container's current state.
docker start standby activates the replacement; docker stop retiring quiets the old worker.
Inspect the final list and make sure metrics was not stopped.
explanation: A safe handoff changes only the intended lifecycle states: bring the replacement up, retire the old process, and preserve supporting services and container identity.
